speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng
text: asked the Minister for Education (a) how many Singaporean students and educational institution staff use a boarding school or educational institution as their registered NRIC address; and (b) what is being done to ensure such individuals continue to have access to Government schemes or services which may require a residential address for purposes of implementation.

speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Education)
text: If educational institution staff or students have difficulty accessing schemes or services provided by such entities, they can directly approach the respective entities who would be best placed to advise on the matter.
